title: Scenarios
subtitle: Project your accounts from a starting date with planned transactions and expected growth.
empty_description: A scenario starts from your real balances on a date you choose, adds planned deposits, withdrawals and transfers, and grows each account at the rate you expect.
delete_confirm: Delete "{{name}}" and all of its planned transactions? This cannot be undone.

form.description: The projection starts from your real balances on the anchor date and runs until the end date.
form.name: Name
form.anchor_hint: Today or earlier. An earlier date lets you compare the plan with what happened.
form.anchor_after_today: The anchor date cannot be after today.
form.end_before_anchor: The end date must be after the anchor date.

transactions.title: Planned transactions
transactions.description: Money you plan to move. Interest and taxes come from each account's growth model.

transaction.description: A hypothetical transaction. It never appears in your real activities.
transaction.received_hint: Optional. Leave it empty to convert at the scenario's exchange rate.
transaction.repeat_hint: Creates one transaction per month on the same day.
transaction.label: Series name
transaction.before_anchor_hint: Transactions on or before the anchor date are not projected.
transaction.error_amount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
transaction.error_until: The series must end on or after its first date.

assumptions.title: Growth
assumptions.description: How each account grows between transactions. Accounts left as "No growth" change only through transactions.
assumptions.fx_description: Yearly change of each currency against {{currency}}. Negative means it loses value.

chart.title: Projection
chart.description: Real value of all accounts (solid) and the projection (dotted), in your base currency.

warnings.UNKNOWN_ACCOUNT: A planned transaction uses an account that no longer exists ({{account}}).
warnings.NO_ANCHOR_VALUATION: {{account}} has no value on the anchor date, so it starts at zero.
warnings.MISSING_FX_RATE: There is no exchange rate for {{currency}}, so those accounts are left out of the total.
